source.verification: Full current original four-page manufacturer IFU, printed page-3 table and its column labels rechecked. Not an abstract or a citation-only verification.

runtimeImport: Only P50 and the per-row printed N. P5/P95 are retained here to verify the original columns; they are not imported as laboratory RI.
statistic: Published group 50th percentile (median), not a reconstructed midpoint, age model or individual result percentile.
unknownReferenceCohortDetails: Unique individuals versus repeated samples within/across rows
doNotBorrow: The separate LH/FSH quotient paragraph has different N and does not establish missing eligibility for the FSH table.
Anckaert E2 ages 18–37, natural-cycle criteria, lactation exclusion and ovulation-relative day definitions do not describe this manufacturer table.

currentAssay.standardization: Enzymun-Test FSH, in turn WHO 2nd IRP 78/549
currentAssay.limitation: Current assay performance and accepted specimens do not establish the original table's cohort matrix or historical low-value procedure.

acceptedApplicationScope.kind: Source-information card outside SVG and ordinary age-reference registry
acceptedApplicationScope.adultPlacement: The whole possible current age must be >18, an application presentation rule only. Source ageDomain remains null.
acceptedApplicationScope.groupSelection: Explicit existing current FSH cycle/menopause context only; no inference or cross-test phase transfer.
acceptedApplicationScope.applicationExclusions: Known contraindication, pregnancy, treatment/stimulation, explicit assay/specimen mismatch, historical or unavailable context; not reported cohort exclusions.
acceptedApplicationScope.postmenopause: A supported table group. 67 IU/L is not a menopause diagnostic threshold.
acceptedApplicationScope.inequalities: Preserve the real FSH parser and existing RI comparison; no value imputation or exact patient marker from a boundary.

validationMeaning: Technical and source-contract checks do not confer independent clinical validation. The PR reports final-SHA runtime, PWA/offline and GitHub check results.
